confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the most reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are less certain and can shift with July demand and events. Cocktail and wine anchors partly rely on beer-price ratios (cocktail about 2x beer, wine about 1.4x beer). EUR figures were converted at an assumed 1.12 USD per EUR. The FX value comes from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rates page, not an opened RBA table, so verify it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Nordic capital price level, benchmarked loosely to Stockholm, with Helsinki-specific adjustments for restaurant, alcohol and hotel pricing. No single exact comparison city was used.
